facts.value: In this course, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics related to business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends. A variety of exercises will promote the linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and lay the foundation for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects.
